bio.text: Lance Russell, a Republican, is the state's attorney for Fall River and Oglala Lakota counties and the unopposed candidate for South Dakota attorney general in 2026.
He won the Republican nomination at the state party convention.

According to his campaign's July 2025 announcement, as published by the Rapid City Post, Russell previously served 12 years in the Legislature (eight in the House and four in the Senate) and holds a Juris Doctor from the University of South Dakota School of Law.

sources.title: Lance Russell, Fall River and Oglala Lakota County State's Attorney, to run for Attorney General
